code_label: Quantum method proposed for risk parity
text_span: a novel QAOAz solution (QAOAz-RP) is proposed
rationale: States the paper's main methodological contribution for the RP model.

code_label: PSO used to tune quantum parameters
text_span: a Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) optimizer is introduced to tune the parameters of the quantum circuits
rationale: Identifies the key hybrid optimization design choice.

code_label: Reported superiority on multiple markets
text_span: PSO-QAOAz-RP is significantly better for portfolio optimization than ABC-LP, GWO, GA and QAOAz-RP on eight portfolios in all metrics.
rationale: Summarizes the headline empirical finding for the RP experiments.

code_label: Reported improvement over quantum baselines
text_span: PSO-QAOAz-MV also has advantage for MV model over the quantum algorithms, including QAOA (improves approximate ratio by 54.79% on average) and QAOAz (improves approximate ratio by 15.38% on average).
rationale: Captures the reported comparative performance gain for the MV model.

code_label: Portfolio optimization remains challenging
text_span: Portfolio optimization still faces many challenges, such as the complexity of investment strategies
rationale: Motivates the research by stating an unresolved problem.

code_label: QAOAz extends QAOA to general operators
text_span: Quantum Alternating Operator Ansatz (QAOAz) [17] is a variant of the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm.
rationale: Defines the algorithmic framework used in the paper.

code_label: Risk parity model is more robust
text_span: Compared to the traditional MV model, the RP model does not rely on the prediction of asset return but uses historical volatility data to measure risk, making the allocation results more robust.
rationale: Explains why the RP model is chosen and its claimed advantage.

code_label: XY mixer preserves feasible Hamming weight
text_span: XY-mixers perform pairwise qubit XY rotations, confining the quantum walk to subspaces with a constant Hamming weight
rationale: Describes the constraint-preserving mixer mechanism.

code_label: Ring mixer is shallower than complete graph mixer
text_span: the ring XY-mixer yields a quantum circuit with lower depth compared to the complete graph XY-mixer
rationale: Justifies the chosen mixer topology on resource grounds.

code_label: Binary cardinality constraint for selected assets
text_span: s.t.𝟏𝑇𝑋 = 𝐵
rationale: States the discrete selection constraint used in the model.

code_label: Alternating unitary circuit structure
text_span: alternately applying 𝑈(𝐻𝑏, 𝛽𝑖) and 𝑈(𝐻𝑝, 𝛾𝑖)
rationale: Captures the core QAOAz circuit construction.

code_label: Problem Hamiltonian mapped from objective
text_span: we map it to the Ising Hamiltonian form using the Pauli 𝑍 operators
rationale: Describes the encoding step from classical objective to quantum Hamiltonian.

code_label: Quartic terms handled directly
text_span: directly implementing 𝑍𝑖𝑍𝑗𝑍𝑘𝑍𝑙 terms not only reduces qubit requirements but also maintains the inherent complex interaction dependencies of the problem.
rationale: Highlights a methodological decision in circuit design.

code_label: Parity check method used for higher-order terms
text_span: Inspired by the parity check method [32], quantum circuit for simulating the Hamiltonian of 𝑍𝑖𝑍𝑗𝑍𝑘 and 𝑍𝑖𝑍𝑗𝑍𝑘𝑍𝑙 is illustrated
rationale: Identifies the construction technique for higher-order Hamiltonian terms.

code_label: PSO chosen as derivative-free classical optimizer
text_span: the PSO optimizer to optimize the parameters of the quantum circuits
rationale: States the classical optimization component used to tune circuit parameters.

code_label: Meta-heuristics argued to be effective for many parameters
text_span: meta-heuristic methods can more efficiently search for the required circuit parameters compared to other gradient-free optimizers.
rationale: Provides the rationale for selecting PSO over other optimizers.

code_label: Fitness evaluation requires quantum device
text_span: The computation of the fitness function requires the participation of a quantum device.
rationale: Indicates the hybrid quantum-classical evaluation loop.

code_label: Experimental portfolios span multiple markets
text_span: Portfolios 1–6, we utilized data from Chinese A-shares
rationale: Describes the dataset composition and market coverage.

code_label: Limited problem size due to hardware constraints
text_span: Current quantum computing hardware has limited capabilities, so to ensure the feasibility of the experiment, six specific stocks are selected for each portfolio.
rationale: States an explicit experimental constraint imposed by current hardware.

code_label: Quantum circuit depth fixed at five
text_span: we have set the depth of the quantum circuit to 5
rationale: Records a key experimental hyperparameter.

code_label: PSO hyperparameters specified
text_span: we iterate 10 times, employ 30 particles, set the inertia coefficient to 0.7
rationale: Captures the PSO configuration used in experiments.

code_label: Benchmark algorithms selected
text_span: We selected the swarm intelligence algorithms ABC-LP [9], GWO [11], and GA [11] as the benchmark algorithms
rationale: Identifies the comparison baselines.

code_label: Approximate ratio used as evaluation metric
text_span: we introduced the Approximate Ratio (AR), which provides a clearer indication of the effectiveness of each algorithm’s optimization.
rationale: Specifies an evaluation criterion for the RP experiments.

code_label: RP results favor proposed method on many portfolios
text_span: the average optimization value of the QAOAz-RP on the selected portfolio samples is superior to that of the baseline model in many portfolios
rationale: Summarizes the main RP experimental outcome.

code_label: Lower variability for PSO-enhanced RP method
text_span: The standard deviation of the optimization value for PSO-QAOAz-RP is consistently lower than that of the other methods
rationale: Reports stability improvement from PSO.

code_label: Some portfolios remain difficult for quantum method
text_span: In portfolio 7–8, our quantum method underperforms classical ones.
rationale: Notes a case where the proposed method does not dominate.

code_label: Local optima suggested as explanation
text_span: QAOAz-RP and PSO-QAOAz-RP may therefore be prone to local optima.
rationale: Provides the authors' explanation for weaker performance on some portfolios.

code_label: MV objective function defined
text_span: The definition of the MV model and the derivation of the Hamiltonian can be found in Appendix C
rationale: Points to the MV formulation used in the second experiment.

code_label: PSO-QAOAz-MV best average on MV portfolios
text_span: the PSO-QAOAz-MV demonstrated the best average optimization value performance in portfolio 1–6.
rationale: States the main MV experimental result.

code_label: PSO improves stability in MV experiments
text_span: the standard deviation is also significantly lower than that of other algorithms
rationale: Reports reduced variability for the PSO-enhanced method.

code_label: Ten PSO iterations deemed sufficient
text_span: 10 iterations were sufficient to improve algorithmic performance without incurring excessive computational time
rationale: Summarizes the hyperparameter discussion and convergence observation.

code_label: Circuit depth trade-off discussed
text_span: P=5 offers a reasonable trade-off.
rationale: Reports the chosen depth as a balance among competing factors.

code_label: Quantum noise and error not modeled
text_span: this study does not account for quantum noise and error
rationale: Explicitly states a limitation of the study.

code_label: Short-term focus acknowledged
text_span: with no analysis of long-term market dynamics and the impact of external factors on portfolios.
rationale: Identifies another stated limitation.

code_label: Future work on longer horizons
text_span: Future research could aim to extend the applicability of quantum algorithms to accommodate both short- and long-term investment objectives
rationale: States a proposed direction for future research.

code_label: Future finance applications proposed
text_span: it is promising to explore how QAOA and other quantum algorithms can be applied to more financial areas
rationale: Indicates broader future application areas.
